CustomField.label: Vegetation Risk Score
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Flammability_Rating__c, "Extreme"), 20, IF(ISPICKVAL(Flammability_Rating__c, "High"), 15, IF(ISPICKVAL(Flammability_Rating__c, "Medium"), 8, 3))) + IF(Distance_to_Line__c < Min_Clearance__c, 10, 0) + IF(Trim_Overdue__c, 5, 0)
